title: Adjoining spaces.
officialText:
Natural ventilation for kitchenettes shall not be through openings off another room or
space.
Exception: A kitchenette may open onto a partially enclosed balcony or space above a setback conforming with
Exception 2 of Section 1203.4.1.2.2.
